name: rebuild-keeps-zdo
description: T-214 B2: the frozen-troll watch's last rung (Rebuild after 30 s) drops only the troll's scene object, never its ZDO: the same troll (same ZDO, same backpack) is built again by the game. Before the fix ZNetScene.Destroy deleted the ZDO of an owned object and the troll with its backpack was gone (cliff-walk-high-down). The troll is held still with stt.freezeMob; stt.forceTravelling says it should be on its way.

steps.name: stt.followedPackCount
steps.label: the backpack holds the 7 Wood before the freeze

steps.name: stt.freezeMob
steps.label: the troll stands still (held by the lab)

steps.name: stt.forceTravelling
steps.label: the watch is told the troll should be travelling
10 s reclaim + 30 s rebuild + two checks: the watch reaches the Rebuild rung

steps.name: stt.forceTravelling
steps.label: the troll no longer should travel
the game builds the troll again from the kept ZDO

asserts.name: stt.followedZdoAlive
asserts.label: the ZDO survived the rebuild (same identity)

asserts.name: stt.followedPackCount
asserts.label: the backpack survived the rebuild (7 Wood, read from the ZDO)
the rebuild line says the ZDO is still there
no TrollFrozenWatch line says the ZDO is gone (the phrase is exact: HubMapPins also logs hubs that are gone)
